rejectionReason: Intended behavior: the protocol is designed to manipulate price when below target. Fee revenue generation from this activity is an expected side effect used to increase liquidity depth.
title: Spot price oracle manipulation bypasses targetPrice minimum in claim()
description: _getPhUSDPriceInUSDS() reads getSlot0() (instantaneous spot price, not TWAP). Any caller can flash-manipulate the pool price above targetPrice, call claim(), and unwind. The targetPrice protection is completely bypassable.
impact: The targetPrice protection is completely bypassable. During genuine phUSD depegs, yield can be claimed at a discount when the protocol intended to block claims. Direct value extraction from protocol/Phlimbo stakers.
attackPath: Flash-manipulate the Uniswap pool price to push phUSD spot price above targetPrice
Call claim() which now passes the price check at lines 573-578
Claim yield at a discount during a genuine phUSD depeg
Unwind the flash manipulation to restore pool state
Net profit from the discounted yield claim
recommendation: Replace spot price with TWAP oracle or external oracle. Uniswap V4 supports observation-based TWAP.

relatedCode.description: Price check in claim() using spot price
